product_overview: LeetTracker Pro helps software engineers prepare for technical interviews by exploring company-specific LeetCode questions, reviewing detailed problem workspaces with solutions, and tracking preparation progress. It also includes authentication, mock interview practice, and subscription upgrade paths.
core_goals: Browse and compare interview questions by target company
Filter, search, sort, and track problem progress in a question catalog
Open a dedicated problem workspace to review problem details and multiple solution approaches
Create an account, sign in, and manage session access
Upgrade to Pro through a billing flow
Run a timed mock interview session for a chosen company

features.name: Company Explorer and Question Table
features.description: Users can explore a company-wise LeetCode catalog, narrow the list by difficulty or topic, search by problem name or ID, sort the table, and mark problems as solved.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select a target company -> Filter by difficulty -> Filter by topic tags -> Search by problem name or ID -> Sort the table -> Mark a problem as solved -> See progress update

features.name: Dedicated Dual-Pane Problem Workspace
features.description: Users can open an individual problem workspace to review the statement, metadata, and multiple solution approaches, then copy code or return to the catalog.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open a problem from the catalog -> Read the problem details and metadata -> Switch between solution approaches -> Copy the displayed code -> Return to the dashboard with the previous context restored

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users can register, sign in, view their account details in the header, and sign out of the application.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the sign-in or sign-up flow -> Switch to the registration tab if needed -> Enter email, username, and password -> Submit the form -> See the signed-in account details in the header -> Sign out -> Return to the logged-out state

features.name: Pro Subscription and Stripe Billing
features.description: Users can review plan options and start the upgrade process to move from Free to Pro through Stripe checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the pricing or upgrade flow -> Review Free and Pro tier benefits -> Start the subscription checkout -> Reach the Stripe checkout session

features.name: Company Question Overlap Analysis
features.description: Users can compare multiple companies to find questions that appear across several target companies.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the company overlap tool -> Select two or more companies -> View the overlapping question list

features.name: Mock Interview Simulator
features.description: Users can generate a timed mock interview for a chosen company and work through the selected questions during the session.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the mock interview tool -> Select a company -> Choose an interview duration -> Start the session -> Review and solve the generated questions

routes.description: Main dashboard featuring company-wise LeetCode tracker, filters, search, and problem table
Dual-pane LeetCode problem workspace with problem statement, details, and multi-approach code solutions
Personal prep progress analytics and charts

features.name: Company Explorer and Question Table
features.description: Filter and view LeetCode questions categorized by target tech company, frequency, difficulty, and topics
user_interactions: Select target company from company pill bar or search
Filter by difficulty level Easy, Medium, or Hard
Filter by topic tags like Dynamic Programming, Graphs, Trees
Search questions by name or ID in the search input
Click table column headers to sort by frequency, difficulty, or acceptance
Toggle question solved status checkbox

features.name: Dedicated Dual-Pane Problem Workspace
features.description: Full LeetCode-style problem workspace with problem description and multi-approach solutions
user_interactions: Click on any problem title in the table to open its dedicated workspace
Read problem title, difficulty badge, acceptance rate, and target company tags
Toggle solution approaches between Optimal, Brute Force, and Alternative
Click Copy Code button to copy solution to clipboard
Click Back to Dashboard button to return to problem catalog

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Signup, login, and user profile management with JWT and silent refresh
user_interactions: Click Sign In or Sign Up button in the navigation header
Switch between Login and Register tabs
Enter email and password
Submit form to authenticate
View user email and membership badge in header
Click Logout to end session

features.name: Pro Subscription and Stripe Billing
features.description: Upgrade account to Pro tier with Stripe checkout integration
user_interactions: Click Upgrade to Pro or Pricing button
Review Free vs Pro feature tiers and benefits
Click Subscribe Now to initiate checkout
Redirect to Stripe checkout sandbox session

features.name: Company Question Overlap Analysis
features.description: Compare multiple companies to find overlapping questions
user_interactions: Click Company Overlap tool button in header
Select two or more target companies
View list of common questions asked across selected companies

features.name: Mock Interview Simulator
features.description: Generate timed mock interview question sets for a selected company
user_interactions: Click Mock Interview button
Select company and interview duration
Start interview timer and solve generated questions
